chunks.sanskrit: # Text  anastamitabhārūpas tejasāṃ tamasām api | ya eko 'ntar yadantaś ca tejāṃsi ca tamāṃsi ca
chunks.l1:
## bod-p01-v01 (1)
un-set-sun-light-form / of-powers / of-darknesses / too / who / one / within / what-end / powers / darknesses // bod-p01
chunks.l2: Of unsetting sun-light is His form — of bright powers and of darknesses too. For He is one, within, and powers and darknesses end in Him.
chunks.l3:
Light never setting — bright powers, darknesses, all;
one, within, in whom each shine and shadow fall.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p01-v01 — C1

**SUMMARY.** A light that never sets holds brightness and darkness alike; a solitary inward reality, which both bound.

*Rasa: adbhuta of all-containing light — The sthāyibhāva is wonder: unsetting light wedding bright and dark. All-containing marvel relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p01-v01 — argument map

Never-setting light-form of bright powers and darknesses — darkness included, not opposed (api). One within, in whom powers and darknesses end (yadantaḥ: limit and abode both).

### Open
- yadantaḥ read as limit and abode both — verse lets both stand.

chunks.sanskrit: sa eva sarvabhūtānāṃ svabhāvaḥ parameśvaraḥ | bhāvajātaṃ hi tasyaiva śaktir īśvaratāmayī
chunks.l1:
## bod-p02-v02 (2)
He / of-all-beings / own-nature / supreme-Lord / host-of-things / of-him-alone / power / Lordship-made // bod-p02
chunks.l2: He alone is the own-nature of all beings, the supreme Lord. And the whole host of things is His alone — power, shaped as Lordship.
chunks.l3:
He alone is every being's own-nature, the supreme Lord;
and the whole host of things — His power, Lordship-made.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p02-v02 — C1

**SUMMARY.** That reality is each creature's own-nature, and the world's abundance is power cast in the shape of sovereignty.

*Rasa: vīra of identity stated — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: He alone, His alone. Identity relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p02-v02 — argument map

He alone is beings' own-nature, the supreme Lord (eva in identity). Therefore the whole host of things is His power, shaped as Lordship (īśvaratāmayī: form, not second entity).

### Open
- īśvaratāmayī read as power's form, not a second entity.

chunks.sanskrit: śaktiś ca śaktimadrūpād vyatirekam na vāñchati | tādātmyam anayor nityaṃ vahnidāhikayor iva
chunks.l1:
## bod-p03-v03 (3)
Power / from-power-possessor-form / difference / does-not-desire / identity / of-these-two / eternal / as / fire-burning // bod-p03
chunks.l2: Power wants no apartness from the power-bearer. The two are eternally one — as fire is one with its burning.
chunks.l3:
Power wants no parting from her bearer — never, ever;
the two are eternally one — as fire is one with burning.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p03-v03 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Power refuses any parting from its bearer — one eternally, as burning is one with fire.

*Rasa: śṛṅgāra-adbhuta of inseparables — The sthāyibhāva is love-wonder: no parting ever wanted. Union relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p03-v03 — argument map

Power wants no apartness from the power-bearer (na vāñchati: will, not mechanism). Eternal identity of the two — sealed by fire-and-burning only ground offered.

### Open
- na vāñchati personifies non-separation as will — kept as stated.

chunks.sanskrit: sa eva bhairavo devo jagadbharaṇalakṣaṇaḥ | svātmādṛṣe samagraṃ hi yacchaktyā pratibimbitam
chunks.l1:
## bod-p04-v04 (4)
He / Bhairava / god / world-bearing-characterized / in-own-self-vision / whole / by-power / reflected // bod-p04
chunks.l2: He alone is Bhairava, the god whose very mark is bearing the world. In the mirror of His own self-seeing, the whole stands reflected — by power.
chunks.l3:
He alone is Bhairava, the world-bearing god;
in His own seeing's mirror stands the whole, mirrored by power.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p04-v04 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Bhairava bears the world by mirroring it within His own seeing.

*Rasa: adbhuta of world mirrored whole — The sthāyibhāva is wonder: the world carried in a glance. Mirroring relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p04-v04 — argument map

He alone Bhairava, world-bearing-marked; reflection by power His manner (no emanation language). Vision itself the mirror (svātmādṛś); no reflecting agent besides power named.

### Open
- Mirror-not-place reading; power sole agent.

chunks.sanskrit: tasyaivaiṣā parā devī svarūpāmarśanotsukā | pūrṇatvaṃ sarvabhaveṣu yasyā nālpaṃ na cādhikam
chunks.l1:
## bod-p05-v05 (5)
Of-him-alone / supreme / goddess / own-nature-grasping-eager / fullness / in-all-beings / of-whom / neither-little / nor / excess // bod-p05
chunks.l2: His alone is the supreme goddess, hungry only to grasp His own nature. She is fullness in all beings — in whom there is neither too little nor too much.
chunks.l3:
His alone is the goddess supreme, hungry to grasp His nature;
fullness in all beings — never little, never more.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p05-v05 — C1

**SUMMARY.** His goddess, grasp-eager, fills all exactly — never short, never over.

*Rasa: śṛṅgāra of bounded hunger — The sthāyibhāva is love: Hers, hungry, exact. Belonging relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p05-v05 — argument map

His alone the supreme goddess, eager only for own-nature-grasping (desire bounded as granted). Exact fullness in all beings: neither little nor excess (definition of pūrṇatva).

### Open
- utsukā appetite bounded to grasping; exactness not approximation.

chunks.sanskrit: eṣa devo 'nayā devyā nityaṃ krīḍārasotsukaḥ | vicitrān sṛṣṭisaṃhārān vidhatte yugapad vibhuḥ
chunks.l1:
## bod-p06-v06 (6)
This / god / by-this / goddess / always / play-joy-eager / varied / creation-dissolution / does / simultaneously / all-pervading // bod-p06
chunks.l2: This god, with this goddess, is forever eager for the joy of play. Varied makings and unmakings He works at once — everywhere at once.
chunks.l3:
This god, with this goddess, forever eager for play's delight;
varied makings and unmakings He works at once — the all-pervading.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p06-v06 — C1

**SUMMARY.** At play together, they make and unmake worlds in a single stroke.

*Rasa: ānanda-vīra of play — The sthāyibhāva is exuberant joy: play-eager, co-occurrent worlds. Play relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p06-v06 — argument map

Always play-joy-eager (mood); varied creation-dissolution at once (act). Simultaneity needs ubiquity: yugapad load-bearing, vibhuḥ closing.

### Open
- yugapad unsoftened (co-occur, not alternate); vibhuḥ required by it.

chunks.sanskrit: atidurghaṭakāritvam asyānuttaram eva yat | etad eva svatantratvam aisvaryaṃ bodharūpatā
chunks.l1:
## bod-p07-v07 (7)
Hard-to-accomplish / of-it / unsurpassed / indeed / what / that-itself / autonomy / lordship / awareness-form // bod-p07
chunks.l2: What is hardest to do is His, and it is unsurpassed. That itself is His freedom, His lordship, His awareness-form.
chunks.l3:
What is hardest to do is His — and none is higher;
that itself is freedom, lordship, awareness-nature.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p07-v07 — C1

**SUMMARY.** The hardest deed belongs to Him and has no higher — and it is freedom, lordship, awareness-form in one.

*Rasa: vīra of equation — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: hardest, highest, freest, most aware — one. Equation relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p07-v07 — argument map

Hard-to-accomplish of it, unsurpassed indeed (rank, not task). Equation: that itself autonomy, lordship, awareness-form — no agent, no verb beyond is.

### Open
- atidurghaṭakāritva as rank; agentless equation.

chunks.sanskrit: paricchinnaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila lakṣaṇam | jaḍād vilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate
chunks.l1:
## bod-p08-v08 (8)
Limited-light-ness / of-inert / indeed / mark / from-inert / different / awareness / since / not / measured // bod-p08
chunks.l2: To shine only in part — that is the mark of the inert. Awareness is otherwise than the inert, for no measure contains it.
chunks.l3:
To shine only in part — that is the mark of the inert;
awareness stands apart from the inert, for it cannot be measured.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p08-v08 — C1

**SUMMARY.** The inert is defined by shining only partially; awareness stands apart from it by escaping all measure.

*Rasa: vīra of criterion — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: measure tried, awareness elsewhere. Uncontainability relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p08-v08 — argument map

Limited light defines inert (mark); unmeasured awareness differs (reason: not measured). na parimīyate active (evades measure); kila shared ground, no irony.

### Open
- Active evasion reading; kila unironic.

chunks.sanskrit: evam asya svatantrasya nijaśaktyupabhedinaḥ | svātmagāḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārāḥ svarūpatvena saṃsthitāḥ
chunks.l1:
## bod-p09-v09 (9)
Thus / of-it / autonomous / by-own-power-distinction / own-self / creation-dissolution / as-nature / stand // bod-p09
chunks.l2: So it is with the free one, distinguishing by His own power: makings and unmakings rest in His own self, standing as His very nature.
chunks.l3:
So of the free one, discerning by his own power,
makings and unmakings rest in his own self, standing as his nature.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p09-v09 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Change itself — every making and unmaking — rests inside the free one, distinguished by His own power, abiding as His nature rather than departing anywhere.

*Rasa: śānta of abiding — The sthāyibhāva is peace: makings resting, nowhere departing. Abiding relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p09-v09 — argument map

Autonomous by own-power-distinction; creations stand as own nature, gone to own self (arrival-without-departure, durative stand).

### Open
- svātmagāḥ arrival reading; saṃsthitāḥ durative.

chunks.sanskrit: teṣu vaicitryam atyantam ūrdhvādhas tiryag eva yat | bhuvanāni tadaṃśāś ca sukhaduḥkhamatiś ca yā
chunks.l1:
## bod-p10-v10 (10)
In-them / variety / extreme / up-down / across / what / worlds / their-parts / pleasure-pain-mind / what // bod-p10
chunks.l2: In them, variety runs to the extreme — upward, downward, across. Worlds and their fragments, pleasure and pain and mind.
chunks.l3:
In them, variety runs to the uttermost — high, low, athwart;
worlds and their fragments, pleasure, pain, and mind.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p10-v10 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Variety is totalized first: every extreme, in all three directions, across outer worlds and their fragments and inner pleasure, pain, and mind.

*Rasa: adbhuta of totality — The sthāyibhāva is wonder: high low across, outer inner, complete. Totality relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p10-v10 — argument map

Teṣu back to verse 9's makings (inventory, no explaining). Three directions, outer worlds-and-parts, inner pleasure-pain-mind — one list, no inner/outer split (Academy variant atir-bhavaḥ noted).

### Open
- teṣu anaphoric; inner-outer undivided; Academy variant logged.

chunks.sanskrit: yad etasyāparijñānaṃ tatsvātantryaṃ hi varṇitam | sa eva khalu saṃsāro mūḍānāṃ yo vibhīṣakaḥ
chunks.l1:
## bod-p11-v11 (11)
What / of-it / non-knowledge / that / its-autonomy / thus / it / indeed / saṃsāra / of-fools / who / terrifying // bod-p11
chunks.l2: Not to know this is called His freedom. And that is saṃsāra itself — a terror to the deluded.
chunks.l3:
Not to know this is called His freedom — that is told;
and that itself is saṃsāra — to the deluded, a terror.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p11-v11 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Then its cause is named: missing this freedom is itself freedom under description — and that mis-knowing is bondage, dreadful to the deluded.

*Rasa: karuṇa-bhaya of bondage named — The sthāyibhāva is tempered dread: terror named, freedom underneath. Naming relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p11-v11 — argument map

Non-knowledge of this = autonomy described (hi emphasis, equation over explanation). That itself = saṃsāra, terrifying to fools only (vibhīṣaka bounds the dread).

### Open
- hi emphatic; dread bounded to fools (autonomy itself unterrifying).

chunks.sanskrit: tatprasādarasād eva gurvāgamata eva vā | śāstrād vā parameśasya yasmāt kasmād upāgatam
chunks.l1:
## bod-p12-v12 (12)
From-that / grace-sap / or / from-teacher-scripture / or / from-scripture / of-supreme-Lord / from-which / from-which / approached // bod-p12
chunks.l2: From the sap of His grace, or from the teacher's handed word, or from the Lord's own scripture — from whichever, it is reached.
chunks.l3:
From grace's sap, or the teacher's handed word,
or the Lord's own scripture — from wherever, it is reached.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p12-v12 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Three entries stand open — the sap of grace, the teacher's transmitted word, the Lord's scripture — and whichever one arrival comes through counts as arrival.

*Rasa: prasāda-śānta of open doors — The sthāyibhāva is peace: grace, teacher, scripture — any door. Openness relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p12-v12 — argument map

Three doors unranked: grace-sap, teacher-scripture, Lord's scripture. yasmāt kasmāt indifferent to route; upāgatam content unnamed (verse 13 names it).

### Open
- No ranking imported; arrival-content deferred.

chunks.sanskrit: yat tattvasya parijñānaṃ sa mokṣaḥ parameśataḥ | tat pūrṇatvaṃ prabuddhānāṃ jīvanmuktiś ca sā smṛtā
chunks.l1:
## bod-p13-v13 (13)
What / of-reality / full-knowledge / that / liberation / from-supreme-Lord / That / fullness / of-awakened / living-liberation / that / remembered // bod-p13
chunks.l2: To know reality through and through — that is release, from the supreme Lord. That is the fullness of the awakened: freedom while living, as the remembered teaching holds.
chunks.l3:
To know the real through and through — release, from the supreme Lord;
that is the awakened's fullness: while living, free — as is remembered.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p13-v13 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Knowing reality to the bottom is release, a fullness belonging to the awakened, freedom lived while living, handed down as remembered teaching.

*Rasa: śānta of release named — The sthāyibhāva is peace: known, released, full, living, remembered. Identity relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p13-v13 — argument map

Four-term identity (not stages): full knowledge = liberation = fullness = living liberation. parameśataḥ source-and-domain; sā smṛtā transmission-close.

### Open
- Source-domain reading; memory-lineage close.

chunks.sanskrit: etau bandhavimokṣau ca parameśasvarūpataḥ | na bhidyete na bhedo hi tattvataḥ parameśvare
chunks.l1:
## bod-p14-v14 (14)
These-two / bondage / liberation / from-supreme-Lord-nature / Not / they-differ / no / difference / in-truth / in-supreme-Lord // bod-p14
chunks.l2: Bondage and release both come of the Lord's own nature. The two do not split apart; in truth, in the supreme Lord, there is no split.
chunks.l3:
Bondage and release, both from the Lord's own nature, never part;
in truth, in the Lord, there is no split.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p14-v14 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Bondage and release both issue from the Lord's nature and do not come apart in Him — in truth, no split.

*Rasa: śānta-vīra of non-difference — The sthāyibhāva is peace: bondage release, undivided, twice said. Doubled negation relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p14-v14 — argument map

Pair from Lord's nature; doubled negation (na bhidyete, na bhedo hi) is emphasis. tattvataḥ reconciles by level (verse 11's dread stands phenomenally); pure position, no practice.

### Open
- Level-reconciliation (no cancellation); emphasis-not-redundancy.

chunks.sanskrit: ittham icchākalājñānaśaktiśūlāmbujāśritaḥ | bhairavaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ svabhāvaḥ pariśīlyate
chunks.l1:
## bod-p15-v15 (15)
Thus / will-power / art / knowledge / power / trident / lotus / resorted / Bhairava / of-all-things / own-nature / is-examined // bod-p15
chunks.l2: So it is: resting on the lotus of the trident — will, art, knowledge, power — Bhairava, the own-nature of all things, is to be dwelt upon.
chunks.l3:
Thus, resting on will, art, knowledge, power, trident, lotus —
Bhairava, the own-nature of all things, is to be contemplated.
chunks.c1:
## bod-p15-v15 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Thus — on will, art, knowledge, power, trident, lotus stayed — Bhairava, all things' own-nature, to be dwelt and weighed.

*Rasa: śānta of closing dwelling — The sthāyibhāva is peace: stayed, stated, dwelt upon. Closing relished.*
chunks.argmap:
## bod-p15-v15 — argument map

Emblem: will-art-knowledge-power trident-lotus seat, unexpanded lotus symbolism. Closing word restates verse 2 (sarvabhāva own-nature); passive enjoins ongoing dwelling (SOURCE short-a variant noted).

### Open
- Lotus unexpanded; dwelling-not-rite; short-a variant logged.
